title.en: To the Tune Tianjingsha: Autumn Thoughts

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Yuan dynasty song (sanqu); the author died around 1321.
basis.zh: 元散曲，作者约卒于 1321 年。

note.en: A sanqu, the song-lyric of the Yuan dynasty, and the most famous one: its first three lines contain no verbs, only nine things set side by side, and the scene assembles itself. Wikisource records 'level sand' as a variant for 'someone's home'. The traveller at the end is looking at a house that is not his, and that is the whole poem.
note.zh: 这是一首元代散曲，也是最有名的一首：前三句没有一个动词，只把九样东西并排放在一起，画面便自己拼成了。维基文库把“人家”另作“平沙”列为异文。结尾的游子望见的是一户不属于他的人家，这就是整首曲子。

excerpt.en: A small bridge, flowing water, someone's home.

gloss.en: Crows at dusk, coming back to roost.
gloss.zh: 昏鸦：黄昏时归巢的乌鸦。

gloss.en: A heartbroken person: the traveller, sick with longing for home.
gloss.zh: 断肠人：形容伤心到极点的人，这里指漂泊天涯的游子。

gloss.en: The edge of the sky: very far from home.
gloss.zh: 天涯：天边，指远离家乡的地方。
